rounding_policy: All monetary values in decision analysis and property tables are rounded to the nearest $10 increment. Statutory percentages and rates are cited directly from official primary sources.

sources.title: IR-2026-133 & Revenue Procedure 2026-35 — Tax Year 2027 Annual Inflation Adjustments (Working Families Tax Cuts)
sources.verified_facts: Confirms 2026 federal estate basic exclusion amount of $15,000,000 ($30,000,000 married with DSUE portability) and 2027 basic exclusion amount of $15,480,000 ($30,960,000 married with portability); annual gift exclusion rises from $19,000 (2026) to $20,000 (2027); top individual income tax bracket 37%.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 706 (Rev. July 2026) — United States Estate (and Generation-Skipping Transfer) Tax Return
sources.verified_facts: Confirms 2026 basic exclusion amount $15,000,000, GST exemption $15,000,000, basic credit $5,945,800 ($5,945,800 exact / $5,945,800 rounded to $10), top estate tax rate 40% under IRC §2001(c), 9-month filing deadline after death (plus 6-month Form 4768 extension), and DSUE portability election rules.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 709 — United States Gift (and Generation-Skipping Transfer) Tax Return
sources.verified_facts: Confirms annual gift tax exclusion ($19,000 per recipient in 2026; $20,000 in 2027 per IR-2026-133) and lifetime taxable gift reduction of the unified estate/gift basic exclusion.

sources.title: Gifts & Inheritances Basis FAQ & Publication 551 (Basis of Assets, IRC §1014)
sources.verified_facts: Basis of property inherited from a decedent is generally Fair Market Value (FMV) on the date of death (or alternate valuation date under IRC §2032 if elected and eligible), eliminating pre-death unrealized capital gain upon immediate post-death sale.

sources.title: Revenue Ruling 2023-2 (Internal Revenue Bulletin 2023-16) — Basis of Assets in Irrevocable Grantor Trust Excluded from Gross Estate
sources.verified_facts: Holds that assets in an irrevocable grantor trust that are NOT included in the deceased grantor's gross estate at death do NOT receive an IRC §1014 step-up in basis; revocable living trust assets included in the gross estate DO receive IRC §1014 basis adjustment.

sources.title: Topic No. 409 — Capital Gains and Losses (Long-Term Holding Period for Inherited Property)
sources.verified_facts: Confirms federal long-term capital gains tax rates of 0%, 15%, and 20% and that inherited property is treated as held long-term regardless of actual holding duration.

sources.title: Topic No. 701 & Publication 523 — Sale of Your Home (IRC §121 Principal Residence Exclusion)
sources.verified_facts: Up to $250,000 ($500,000 married filing jointly) of post-inheritance capital gain excluded if the heir owns and uses the home as principal residence for at least 2 of the 5 years prior to sale; statutory cap is not indexed for inflation.

sources.title: Topic No. 559 — Net Investment Income Tax (IRC §1411)
sources.verified_facts: 3.8% Net Investment Income Tax applies to net rental income and taxable capital gains when MAGI exceeds $200,000 (single) or $250,000 (married filing jointly); thresholds are not indexed for inflation.

sources.title: Publication 527 — Residential Rental Property (MACRS 27.5-Year Straight-Line Depreciation)
sources.verified_facts: Residential rental buildings (excluding land) placed in service after inheritance are depreciated straight-line over 27.5 years under MACRS GDS using the stepped-up building basis.

sources.title: California Revenue and Taxation Code §§13301–13302 — Prohibition of Gift and Death Taxes
sources.verified_facts: Prohibits the State of California and any local political subdivision from imposing any gift, inheritance, succession, legacy, or estate tax ($0 state/local inheritance tax; §13302 pickup tax is $0 following repeal of federal state death tax credit).

sources.title: Capital Gains and Losses & Schedule CA (540) Instructions
sources.verified_facts: California taxes all capital gains as ordinary income (1% to 12.3%, plus 1% Mental Health Services Tax over $1,000,000 = 13.3% top marginal rate); conforms to IRC §1014 step-up and IRC §121 exclusion.

sources.title: Rental Income & Form 541 Fiduciary Income Tax Instructions
sources.verified_facts: Net California-source rental income is taxed at California ordinary income rates regardless of owner's state of residence; fiduciary trust returns use Form 541.

sources.title: Proposition 19 — Intergenerational Transfer Exclusion Overview & Publication 800-1
sources.verified_facts: Parent-child / grandparent-grandchild exclusion applies ONLY to transferor's principal residence (or family farm) that becomes transferee's principal residence within 1 year; Homeowners' Exemption (BOE-266) must be filed within 1 year; BOE-19-P/G within 3 years; moving out later removes the exclusion as of the next Jan 1 lien date; non-principal-residence / rental units are reassessed to 100% FMV.

sources.title: Letter to Assessors No. 2025/009 & News Release NR 25-02 — Adjustment of Proposition 19 $1 Million Exclusion Amount
sources.verified_facts: Confirms Prop 19 value cap equals Factored Base Year Value plus $1,044,586 ($1,044,590 rounded to nearest $10) for transfers Feb 16, 2025 through Feb 15, 2027 (up 2.15% from $1,022,600 for 2023–2025 and $1,000,000 for 2021–2023), adjusted biennially via FHFA California HPI.

sources.title: Letters to Assessors No. 2024/053 & No. 2026/002 — California Consumer Price Index (Prop 13 Inflation Factors through 2026-27)
SB 539 / SB 293 / SB 974 — Revenue and Taxation Code §63.2 & §218 (Intergenerational Transfers & $7,000 Homeowners' Exemption)
sources.verified_facts: Codifies Prop 19 trust transfer rules (R&TC §63.2(e)(9) includes transfers via inter vivos or testamentary trusts), 2025–2026 wildfire/special-needs trust bills (SB 293, SB 974), and R&TC §218 $7,000 Homeowners' Exemption.

sources.title: Proposed Constitutional Initiative Advisory — Repeal of Proposition 19 Property Tax Rules & LAO Step-Up Analysis
sources.verified_facts: Documents repeated citizen initiative attempts to repeal Prop 19; none has enacted a repeal as of Nov 2026, so Prop 19 remains binding constitutional law.

sources.agency: Judicial Council of California / Santa Clara Superior Court
sources.title: California Courts Formal Probate Overview & Probate Trusts Administration (Prob. Code §§16061.7, 10800, 10810)
sources.verified_facts: Confirms revocable trust administration avoids formal probate court supervision and statutory probate fees; successor trustee must serve Probate Code §16061.7 notification within 60 days of death (triggering 120-day contest window under §16061.8) and notify County Assessor within 150 days (R&TC §480(b)).

sources.agency: County of Santa Clara Department of Tax and Collections & Controller-Treasurer
sources.title: Compilation of Tax Rates & Information FY 2025-2026 and Secured Property Tax Portal
sources.verified_facts: Confirms 1.00% Prop 13 general levy plus voter-approved school/college/water district debt rates (~1.14%–1.24% ad valorem across local TRAs, plus flat parcel taxes/assessments collected on the secured bill).

sources.title: Recording Document Fees & County Documentary Transfer Tax Schedule
sources.verified_facts: County Documentary Transfer Tax is $0.55 per $500 ($1.10 per $1,000 = 0.11%) of sale price; city conveyance tax ($1.65 per $500) applies only to San Jose, Palo Alto, and Mountain View—NOT general-law cities in the county; inheritance/gift transfers for $0 consideration are exempt.

sources.title: General Plan Chapter 6 & Chapter 8 — Municipal Water Infrastructure (San Jose Water Co. Lease & California Water Service)
sources.verified_facts: Confirms residential parcels in jurisdiction are served by San Jose Water Company (operating the leased municipal water system) or California Water Service, regulated by the CPUC, with wholesale supply from Santa Clara Valley Water District.

sources.title: Decision 22-12-056 (Net Billing Tariff / NEM 3.0), D.16-01-044 (20-Year NEM Legacy Period), and D.24-05-028 (Fixed Charge)
sources.verified_facts: Legacy NEM 1.0/2.0 retail export credit treatment expires 20 years after original interconnection date, after which solar systems transition to the Net Billing Tariff (avoided-cost export credits) plus non-bypassable/fixed base services charges (D.24-05-028).

sources.title: Resolution No. 447-25 (File No. 250876) — FY 2025-2026 Secured Property Tax Rate ($1.18268325 per $100)
sources.verified_facts: Establishes official combined ad valorem property tax rate of 1.18268325% for FY 2025-26; bills on low-base-value parcels also include flat voter-approved parcel taxes and special assessments (~$1,090/yr implied on [PROPERTY_B]).

sources.agency: City & County of San Francisco Assessor-Recorder
sources.title: Real Property Transfer Tax Tiers & Exemptions (SF Bus. & Tax Regs. Code Art. 12-C)
sources.verified_facts: Inheritance and bona fide gifts are exempt ($0); sales are taxed on ENTIRE price at 0.68% ($250k–<$1M), 0.75% ($1M–<$5M), and 2.25% ($5M–<$10M).

sources.title: Current Allowable Rent Increase Rates (Mar 1, 2026 – Feb 28, 2027: 1.6%), AB 1482, & Just Cause Evictions
sources.verified_facts: Confirms 1.6% annual allowable rent increase for SF rent-controlled units (Mar 2026–Feb 2027; 1.4% in 2025–26; 1.7% in 2024–25) and just-cause / owner-move-in rules under SF Admin. Code Ch. 37.

sources.title: Proposition 218 Notice — Adopted FYE 2026 & Proposed FYE 2027–2028 Multi-Family Water, Wastewater & Stormwater Rates
sources.verified_facts: Confirms FYE 2026 multi-family Tier 1 water ($11.24/Ccf -> $12.03/Ccf FY27) plus residential wastewater ($18.72/Ccf -> $20.74/Ccf FY27 on 95% return factor) plus parcel stormwater/service charges.

sources.title: Top Ten Tips for Finding Residential Insurance, Homeowner Premium Comparison Tool & CDI Statewide Experience Data
sources.verified_facts: Provides official CDI Homeowner Premium Comparison Tool, Home Insurance Finder (HO-3 primary residence vs. Dwelling Fire DP-3 landlord policies), and California FAIR Plan backstop guidance; CDI statewide all-forms residential average is ~$2,340/yr (2025 experience year), while multi-million-dollar Bay Area replacement-cost and 3-unit landlord policies require parcel-specific underwriting quotes.

sources.verified_facts: Official Nov 9, 2026 U.S. Treasury yields: 3-Month T-bill 4.24%, 1-Year 4.38%, 10-Year 4.88%, 20-Year 5.29%, 30-Year 5.26%, establishing verified risk-free savings/bond benchmarks.

sources.title: FHFA House Price Index (HPI) Quarterly Report (2026Q2) — California Long-Run Appreciation Series
sources.verified_facts: Official statutory index used by CA BOE for Prop 19 biennial adjustments; reports +317.15% cumulative California HPI appreciation since 1991Q1 (~4.1% compound annual nominal growth) alongside near-term cyclical softness (-0.62% 1-yr as of 2026Q2).

sources.verified_facts: Official federal inflation benchmark underlying IRS Chained CPI tax indexing, AB 1482 / SF Rent Board CPI formulas, and long-run operating cost escalation assumptions.
